about: The Viera Voice reports that Brevard County Sheriff's Office Charity, Inc. will host the Light Up Viera Christmas Parade on Saturday, November 28, 2026, and that the 2026 parade is the charity's third year hosting. Fireworks go up from an area next to Viera Middle School at 6 PM, and the parade starts right after.

The same article says the route begins at Judge Fran Jamieson Way and Stadium Parkway, heads down Stadium Parkway, turns left on Viera Boulevard and ends at Manatee Elementary. More than 30 floats had registered by late October, and registration was still open then.

The Viera Voice notes that Santa Claus and Mrs. Claus love coming to Viera for the annual parade. The Fun 4 Space Coast Kids listing adds that the route passes high school bands and displays, and it gives the cost as free.

The viera.com page for the parade still shows last year's November 29, 2025 date, so this listing follows the 2026 date from the Viera Voice and the Fun 4 Space Coast Kids calendar. The viera.com page says do not park golf carts over sidewalks or in undesignated areas.
faq: When is the Light Up Viera Christmas Parade?
Saturday, November 28, 2026. Fireworks start at 6 PM and the parade follows right after.
Who hosts it?
Brevard County Sheriff's Office Charity, Inc., in partnership with the Viera Company.
Where does the route go?
It starts at Judge Fran Jamieson Way and Stadium Parkway, goes down Stadium Parkway, turns left on Viera Boulevard and ends at Manatee Elementary.
Is it free?
The Fun 4 Space Coast Kids listing says it is free.
Where do the fireworks go off?
From an area next to Viera Middle School, according to the Viera Voice.
Will Santa be there?
The Viera Voice says Santa and Mrs. Claus love coming to the parade.
How many floats are expected?
More than 30 had registered by late October.

about: The Viera events calendar describes Carols in the Park as a festive evening of music and cheer at The Avenue Viera, running December 1 through December 24, 6 PM to 8 PM. Performances are at 6 PM and 7 PM in Central Park, and the singers are local schools, choirs and community talent.
The Avenue Viera is at 2261 Town Center Avenue, according to the Fun 4 Space Coast Kids calendar, which lists the first night as Tuesday, December 1, 2026.

The Avenue Viera's own page for the 2025 season noted that carols paused for one night on December 18 for a Chanukah menorah lighting. The 2026 listing does not repeat that note, so check the host calendar before you plan around a single night.
No price is printed on the listing. Santa also visits Central Park through December 24, so a family can pair a carol with a visit.

The Viera events calendar page for Carols in the Park was last updated in September 2026 and names The Avenue Viera as the presenter. It also lists the Christmas Magic Show on Saturday, December 12, from 3 PM to 4:30 PM at Advent Lutheran Church, and Holiday Lights at Brevard Zoo on select nights.
Brevard Zoo's Holiday Lights runs November 20 to January 2 from 6 PM to 9 PM, and the zoo is a short trip from Viera.
faq: When is Carols in the Park?
December 1 to December 24, 2026, from 6 PM to 8 PM, with performances at 6 PM and 7 PM.
Where is it?
Central Park at The Avenue Viera, 2261 Town Center Avenue, Viera.
Who performs?
Local schools, choirs and community talent.
Is there a price?
The listing does not show one.
Does it run every night?
The listing gives a December 1 to 24 range. Check the host calendar for any skipped night.
Can we see Santa nearby?
Santa visits Central Park on listed dates through December 24.
Is there another show in Viera?
The Viera calendar lists a Christmas Magic Show on December 12 from 3 PM to 4:30 PM at Advent Lutheran Church.
Is the event outdoors?
It is held in Central Park at The Avenue Viera.

about: The Avenue Viera lists Santa Visits 2026 as a season that runs from Saturday, November 14 to Thursday, December 24, with Santa and Mrs. Claus in Central Park for festive photos and holiday cheer. This listing covers the dates from November 28 on.

Late November and early December visits are weekend afternoons, 2 PM to 5 PM. From Thursday, December 10 the hours move later. December 10 is 3 PM to 6 PM, most December evenings are 5 PM to 7:30 PM, and Sunday, December 13 and 20 and Thursday, December 24 are noon to 2:30 PM.

The Santa Mini Session is a ten minute portrait slot at $155. It includes five professionally edited photos of your choice and an online proofing gallery delivered within seven days. Optional upgrades are listed at $25 for expedited editing and $150 for a full gallery.
The host also lists complimentary visits and Sensory Santa visits without a price. The Sensory Santa visits have their own listing on the Melbourne page of this site.

The Avenue Viera's Santa Mini Session page lists early dates on Saturday and Sunday, November 14 and 15, which are before this listing begins. Online booking goes through a registration link on the host page.
The Viera Christmas Parade and fireworks are Saturday, November 28, a few hours after Santa's 2 PM to 5 PM visit that day, so one trip can cover both.
faq: When can we visit Santa at The Avenue Viera?
Santa is in Central Park on listed dates from November 28 to December 24. Hours are 2 PM to 5 PM on early weekends and mostly 5 PM to 7:30 PM in December.
How much is a Santa Mini Session?
$155 for ten minutes, with five edited photos.
What do the photos include?
Five professionally edited photos of your choice and an online proofing gallery delivered within seven days.
Are there upgrades?
Yes. Expedited editing is $25 and a full gallery upgrade is $150.
Where is Santa?
Central Park at The Avenue Viera, 2261 Town Center Avenue.
Are other visit prices listed?
The host does not print a price for the other visits.
Is Santa there on parade day?
Yes, Santa is in Central Park on Saturday, November 28, from 2 PM to 5 PM, before the Light Up Viera parade that evening.
Where do I book?
Through the registration link on The Avenue Viera Santa page.

about: VieraNow lists the FECRW Santa Train for Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 2:15 PM sharp. The location is the FEC Rail Crossing on Gus Hipp Boulevard in Rockledge, and the event is free.
Santa arrives by decorated train. The listing names photo opportunities, a Christmas village and vendors on site, plus gifts for children in VPK through 4th grade.

The host is the Rockledge Public Safety Department, together with Florida East Coast Railway. An allevents.in listing for the same Santa Train gives an earlier start of 1 PM, so use the 2:15 PM arrival time from the VieraNow listing for Santa himself and plan to get there ahead of it.
Light Up Rockledge is the same day, December 5, from 4 PM to 7 PM at the Rockledge Civic Hub, 530 Barton Boulevard, so a family can do the train and then go to the lighting.
faq: When is the Santa Train in Rockledge?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 2:15 PM sharp.
Where is it?
FEC Rail Crossing, Gus Hipp Boulevard, Rockledge.
Is it free?
Yes, the listing says free.
Who gets gifts?
Children in VPK through 4th grade.
Who hosts it?
The Rockledge Public Safety Department and Florida East Coast Railway.
What else is there?
Photo opportunities, a Christmas village and vendors.
Is there another event the same day?
Light Up Rockledge is December 5 from 4 PM to 7 PM at the Rockledge Civic Hub.

about: Rockledge Gardens lists a free Holiday Gnome Scavenger Hunt for all of December, daily from 9 AM to 5 PM. The host says it runs excluding holidays and during special events, so check the day you plan to go.
The host gives three steps. Grab a map and pencil at the front entrance, find and list the name of each garden gnome, then take the completed map to the pink checkout building to claim a prize.
The gardens add that the hunt is a magical adventure for the whole family and perfect for all ages. The gnome hunt also appears inside the Jingle Mingle evening on December 18.

The gardens also post a free Holiday Market on Sunday, December 6, from 11 AM to 4 PM with 30 plus local makers, fresh fir Christmas trees and live holiday jazz, which pairs well with a gnome hunt visit.

The gardens' monthly Toddler Tuesday storytime for ages 12 months to 5 years is on the third Tuesday, December 15, at 9:30 AM in the Riley Room, with tickets required through Eventbrite. A family visiting that morning can do the gnome hunt afterward.
The gardens' Little Bugs Club Winter Camp is December 28 to 30, 10 AM to 3 PM, for ages 6 to 12, at $150 with a $15 sibling discount.
faq: When is the gnome scavenger hunt?
December 1 to 30, 2026, daily from 9 AM to 5 PM, excluding holidays.
Is it free?
Yes, the host calls it a free scavenger hunt.
How do we play?
Pick up a map and pencil at the front entrance, list each gnome's name, then claim a prize at the pink checkout building.
What ages is it for?
The host says it is perfect for all ages.
Where do we start?
At the front entrance of Rockledge Gardens.
Is there a related evening event?
Jingle Mingle on December 18 includes the gnome hunt plus a movie under the stars.
Is there a toddler program in December?
Toddler Tuesday is December 15 at 9:30 AM for ages 12 months to 5 years, with tickets through Eventbrite.
Is there a winter camp?
Yes, Little Bugs Club Winter Camp is December 28 to 30 for ages 6 to 12, $150.

about: Rockledge Gardens calls Jingle Mingle a magical evening of sparkling decor, twinkling lights and seasonal fun for all ages, with pets included. It is on Friday, December 18, 2026, from 6 PM to 9 PM.

The host lists a fire pit, live carolers playing festive jazz and a search for hidden holiday gnomes with a prize at the end. At 7 PM a classic holiday film plays under the stars, and the host suggests a blanket or chair.

Shoppers can browse the Greenhouse, Market, Botanical Boutique and local guest vendors, with complimentary gift wrapping on purchases. Food on site includes plant-based fare from Garden Party, wood-fired pizza from Nunzi, and sweet treats and hot cocoa from Mad Utter.

Guests who bring a new, unwrapped toy for Toys for Tots of Brevard receive a coupon for a free cup of hot chocolate. The host says outside food and drinks are not permitted. No admission price is printed.

Rockledge Gardens also posts a Make and Take Holiday Wreath Workshop on Saturday, December 12, at 10 AM in its covered Learning Center Pavilion, led by the gardens' content coordinator. Supplies are included for a 16 inch wreath, and the host sends guests to Eventbrite to RSVP.
The gardens say the Friendsgiving drive runs all November, taking food, toys and toiletries in The Market, so Jingle Mingle is the gardens' second toy drive of the season.

Parents should note that the evening is built around a stroll, a fire pit and a lawn movie, so it works for children who like to wander. The host lists the Greenhouse, the Market and the Botanical Boutique as the shopping stops, and gift wrapping is free on everything bought that night.
The gardens' Holiday Market on Sunday, December 6, runs 11 AM to 4 PM, is free to attend and is rain or shine, if the family wants a daytime visit as well.
faq: When is Jingle Mingle?
Friday, December 18, 2026, from 6 PM to 9 PM.
What time is the movie?
A holiday film starts under the stars at 7 PM.
Can we bring pets?
The host says all ages, pets included.
What is the toy drive?
Bring a new, unwrapped toy for Toys for Tots of Brevard and get a coupon for a free hot chocolate.
Can we bring our own food?
No, outside food and drinks are not permitted.
Is there a price?
The host does not print one.
What food is sold?
Plant-based fare from Garden Party, pizza from Nunzi and treats and cocoa from Mad Utter.
Is there a Christmas tree to buy?
The host mentions Christmas cacti, poinsettias and other holiday blooms to take home.
Is there live music?
Yes, live carolers play festive jazz.
Does the gardens have a wreath class?
Yes, a Holiday Wreath Workshop is Saturday, December 12 at 10 AM.
Does the evening include gift wrapping?
Yes, the host offers complimentary gift wrapping on everything you buy.
Where do we sit for the film?
Settle in with a blanket or chair at 7 PM for the film under the stars.
